author: Kusum Jasuja
text: Highly appreciate and recommend Dr. Sukhwant in Chitranjan park, New Delhi for any kind of dental treatment- surgical or medical. His vast experience during MDS Endodontics at AIIMS Delhi and afterwards comes as a blessing for his patients. He is also very spiritual and kind, important qualities for any doctor. My dental treatment was painless aswell as symptom free afterwards too. Thank you! Dr. Kusum NCR

author: Soham Perret
text: I had a great experience with Dr. Sukhwant who is highly professional and caring! I visited his clinic for my rootcanal treatment and he made me feel very comfortable and explained everything very clearly. I am very much satisfied with the quality of his treatment and would definitely recommend this clinic for anyone looking for RCT in Delhi..

author: Shweta Kashyap
text: Their services are absolutely top-notch! Dr. Sukhwant is super attentive and really cares about their patients. I felt completely looked after, and the whole experience was so smooth and professional.

author: Jaspreet Kaur
text: Visits to dentists have been super scary for me in the past. But unlike others, my visit to Dr. Sukhwant sir have been super relaxing. He is an empathetic doctor. He makes one feel relaxed right from the consultation (answering to all the doubts, providing alternatives in any needed) to the post treatment consideration. He is my trustworthy, go-to-dentist now!

author: Mohana Talapatra
text: I cannot recommend Dr Yadav highly enough! I had no idea that a dental experience could be so reassuring, pain-free and the procedure done so expertly and with utmost confidence, as at Dr Yadav's clinic. I came to Dr Yadav after a very disappointing and painful start to my RCT somewhere else, which i had to abandon, because i lost confidence there. Then, I got Dr Yadav's reference from an old family friend and I couldn't have been luckier or happier :) And the best part is that the doctor will not advise any unnecessary procedures and add-ons that many other dentists are prone to suggest, simply to enhance their practice. Dr Yadav listens patiently, advises, explains in detail what you need,  and you are in good safe hands with him. If you need an RCT, please do yourselves a favor and do not look anywhere else but to Dr Yadav for the most pain-free and reassuring RCT procedure or anything else at all! Thank you, Dr Yadav - a fan for life!

author: Saurabh Pangariya
text: My Father got the treatment. After approx 1 month I came here to review. My father is happy with the help and support and understanding shown by Dr. Sukhwant Ji.. 🙏 Dr. explains the options for the treatment/durability/cost involved. Which really one of the main reasons + he did it by himself + take responsibility of his work. That's all we as customer wants. Which u get here. Thank you Dr. Sukhwant Ji. Once again.

author: sulagno basu
text: I had an extraction done at Dr. Sukhwant Yadav's dental clinic on 25.04.2024. I found the services to be excellent and the procedure was performed seamlessly with utmost care and precaution. The clinic is furnished and the paramedic help was apt. I would recommend Dr. Yadav for any dental or ortho-dental issues.
